text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Mame-chin. It's way too early in the 
mornin'.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"Shall we do a tandem run? The distance 
will be—"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"One year from now." Or "two years from 
now"... No, all the way to "the far, 
distant future."

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: And here we are! The Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Who will emerge victorious in this 
festival of racing that has captured 
everyone's gaze?! A massive crowd has 
packed into the stands!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
My victory is inevitable. It is the law of 
the universe.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... it's completely dominated by 
Orfevre... As expected of Japan's 
strongest Umamusume...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Her aura alone is utterly overwhelming... 
I wonder if there's any Umamusume who can 
match her today...

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! At this point, Orfevre is 
straight-up justice! The undisputed, 
absolute only justice!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Crush them, Gold Ship... and Fenomeno too! 
Wipe out all evil that isn't justice!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
Fenomeno's always been our hero of 
justice, right...? She just needs to 
reflect on what she did. Then... I'll look 
up to her again.

text_block_list.name: Child in Black Hat
text_block_list.text: Eep. Why are you here too—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Praying that my victory will lead toward 
someone's future...
